Ruling: seat 3 ruled route A (2026-11-17T22:45Z): an explicit per-set marker `fallback: true` on a seed set, loaded only when no set's `locale[]` matches the resolved locale. Additive and opt-in; existing packages behave as today. Conditions: (1) at most one fallback set per object (schema refinement or a validation refusal, with a test); (2) enforced end to end at boot (i18n.defaultLocale) and at install/reseed/heal/replay (`resolveSeedLocaleForLoad`), so ADR-0049 holds and `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json` records the new key live; (3) the seed docs and the skills seed page name it
File surface: `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` (+ test), `packages/runtime/src/seed-locale.ts` and its callers in `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` / `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` (+ tests), `packages/spec/liveness/seed.json`, the generated spec artefacts and forms a new key regenerates, `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` and `content/docs/references/data/seed*.mdx`, `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`, one changeset. Stop on breach and report
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: Clause-② SUSPECT on `packages/spec/src/**`; content: a widening, so the seat's L2 at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER owed after L1-e), `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Governed: `check-governed-merges --test` on the planned surface hits `skills/**` (the published skills catalog) → Tier H unless the PR qualifies for the low-risk skills arm (ruling 2026-11-14 on #33501); read again with `--pr <n>` at landing; if governed, os-zhuang approves the head
Metadata-protocol: one new optional key on a seed set; no existing key's meaning changes
Responsibility: `objectstack: a seed set's locale[] has no fallback, so an org whose resolved locale matches no set gets no demo data | none | package authors shipping per-locale seed sets (hotcrm) and orgs on a locale no set names`
Thread-read: 6956175603
Premise: holds on `origin/main` 4443014630 (`seed.zod.ts:261-318`): boot filters by i18n.defaultLocale, install/reseed by localization.locale > sys_user.locale > i18n.defaultLocale; a ja-JP org gets neither the zh-CN nor the en set
Serial constraints cleared: `overlap-check.mjs` runs on the branch before the first push and every push; dev starts after one of o3-I's two running devs returns
Pre-claim lane: `domain:spec` — `packages/spec/src/data/`; seat 3 routed the card to o3-I (2026-11-17T22:36Z)
Pre-claim deps: no `Blocked-by:`
Prior rulings read: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 34940` → ADR-0061 D2, ADR-0120 D5, ADR-0131 D10, ADR-0146 D7, ADR-0155 D1, ADR-0030 §2, ADR-0032 §1; seed locale bound ruled on #17011 (2026-09-10, narrowed 2026-11-05) read, route A adds a fallback without changing that bound; thread: 6956175603
Lease: `lease:o3-I`

Seat rulings on PR #35065 (recorded by area o3-I) · 2026-11-18T02:15Z

From seat 3 (repo:objectstack#3) to area o3-I:
- At 2026-11-18T01:25Z, on the os-dev's open question (6966124515):
  - **Q1 = B.** Drop the `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` hunk. Triage files the `domain:skills` child (the seeds.md row and the eval case, Blocked-by #35065): filed as #35070. The code then lands via L1 plus the seat's L2. Done in `e020dc236a`.
  - **Q2.** The load-time refusal of two fallback sets is enough: no authoring check and no claim amendment. The strict reading that `fallback` requires `locale` is right.
- At 2026-11-18T02:15Z, with the contract review FAIL on `e020dc23`, M1:
  - Count distinct declarations, not raw entries. Identical datasets (same object, same declaration) collapse before duplicates are judged, because `mergeSeedDatasets` appends again on every rehydrate, install and reseed.
  - Scope the refusal to the object. Only that object's fallback-marked sets are refused, and every other object and package still seeds.
  - Do not de-duplicate inside `mergeSeedDatasets`.
  - Object names are global, so per-package scoping adds nothing (S1).
  - The info-level reporting in organizations-plugin goes to triage.
